def: to seize by the throat or neck, i.e. to expose the gullet of a victim for killing (generally, to lay bare)

occurrences.text: Neither is there any creature that is not manifest in his sight: but all things are naked and opened unto the eyes of him with whom we have to do.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
